rules: Queue AGENTS.md and docs/interfaces.md preserve queue-to-CY dependency direction and explicit outer integration owners. Bounded metadata must agree with the checked proposed source/installed pair; no runtime effect ownership changes.

modules.responsibility: Declare the verified bounded CY compatibility range
modules.interface: Retain CY >=0.38 while admitting verified CY 0.42 and excluding 0.43; prepare queue version 0.1.3 only after proposed-pair verification
allowed_dependencies: Documented CY outer interfaces and existing queue dependencies
forbidden_dependencies: Queue policy depending on CY or SDK effects
modules.effects: Installer owns dependency resolution; snapshots own proposed metadata; no operational installation or runtime behavior changes

modules.responsibility: Verify queue composition and runner preserve custom YOLO selectors without preparing model catalogue
modules.interface: Submit pipeline/train snapshots without bulk asset preparation; exec unchanged matching CY entrypoint with custom architecture, pretrained and resume settings
allowed_dependencies: Explicit CY integration records and cache boundaries
forbidden_dependencies: Physical GPU work in routine tests
modules.effects: Temporary fixture filesystem and owned subprocesses only; GPU inventory/profile boundaries controlled

contracts.rules: Source and installed metadata must agree and satisfy queue bounds; both packages and entrypoints import outside checkout
Explicit CY caller ownership and negative forbidden-effect/import coverage remain enforced
